<section class="home-intro" aria-label="Profile">
  <h2 class="author-name">Seokju Kang</h2>
  <p class="home-subtitle">Ph.D. Candidate, UNIST</p>

  <figure class="profile-card">
    <img src="assets/profile.jpeg" alt="Seokju Kang" />
  </figure>

  <p>Hello, I'm Seokju Kang. I am currently a Ph.D. student in Management Engineering at UNIST, supervised by Prof. Hyun Jin Jang. Prior to that, I completed my B.S. in Industrial Engineering at Pusan Nat'l University.</p>

  <p>My research domain is in <strong>Financial Engineering</strong>, with particular emphasis on risk management, derivatives pricing, and quantitative methods in finance. I am also working on <strong>AI/OR applications in finance</strong>.</p>
